name: inventory-software-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Smart Inventory Management System

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && (if exist venv\Scripts\python.exe (venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app.main) else (py -3 -m app.main))
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.db:migrate: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location backend; if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe ..\scripts\migration\drop_legacy_tables_now.py } elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 ..\scripts\migration\drop_legacy_tables_now.py } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pyPath = (Get-Command python).Source; if ($pyPath -like '*WindowsApps*') { Write-Error 'Detected Windows Store python stub. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }; python ..\scripts\migration\drop_legacy_tables_now.py } else { Write-Error 'Python not found. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }"
scripts.db:seed: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location backend; if (Test-Path .\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\venv\Scripts\python.exe ..\scripts\admin\create_admin.py } elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { py -3 ..\scripts\admin\create_admin.py } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pyPath = (Get-Command python).Source; if ($pyPath -like '*WindowsApps*') { Write-Error 'Detected Windows Store python stub. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }; python ..\scripts\admin\create_admin.py } else { Write-Error 'Python not found. Install Python 3.10+ or create backend\venv first.'; exit 1 }"
scripts.db:setup:sqlite: npm run db:migrate:sqlite && npm run db:seed:sqlite
